title: ID0412017-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/R3 170001536]-Unable to charge on connector 1 and 3
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Unable to charge on connector 1 and 3
Root cause: Coap polling error, charger running on old FW
Solution: Updated to 6.0.3, issue resolved.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status: Yes
